app_info.subtitle: Specialists · Payroll · Prices · Process
app_info.description: Never86'd helps restaurant merchants find leaks with one agent per job. Call get_operator_system and list_specialists first. Then analyze labor, beverage, or vendor prices from operator-supplied CSVs, or build an Action Shift from a prior-day close. Every result is read-only and Unverified until the merchant confirms the source. No portal passwords. No auto-mail. No theft claims.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the public Never86 operator system pack only. No tenant data and no writes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact merchants, vendors, POS systems, or third-party portals.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify store rules, employee records, or any business state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a public rulebook domain. No store-private memory and no writes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not fetch live merchant statements or log into marketplaces.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change formulas, targets, or operational records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns public marketplace 3P audit rules only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not open DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub merchant portals.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot dispute payouts, issue refunds, or alter statement records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists published public AEO answers. No private restaurant data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not scrape merchant portals or third-party admin pages.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot edit, unpublish, or delete answers.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the public free-agent catalog only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not run agents against live merchant accounts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot enable, disable, or bill seats.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not spawn live workers or contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot hire, fire, or reassign store staff.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists domain specialists and allowed tools for discovery.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not invoke specialists against live merchant data by itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot grant access or change merchant configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes CSV text deliberately supplied by the merchant and does not change schedules, payroll, or employee records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact an employee, payroll provider, POS, or any other external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, discipline, terminate, or otherwise transition an employee or business record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes merchant-supplied beverage CSV text and returns Unverified review leads without writing inventory.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact distributors, change par levels, or open bar POS systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot invent pour cost as verified, accuse theft, or alter inventory counts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Converts verified package sizes and pour specs into portion units without writing inventory or inventing pack size.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact distributors, scales, or POS systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot invent pourSpec, keg size, or case conversion, or alter stock counts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns interview questions for this unit's house pour sizes without writing memory or inventing ounces.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact bars, POS systems, or distributors.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot set pour policy or assume 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 oz for any store.

justifications.read_only_justification: Validates operator-answered pour lines and returns a Memory Curator proposal; it does not auto-approve memory.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not message staff or alter POS buttons.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot write store memory without a human approver.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates Unverified plate or drink cost, or food COGS, from merchant-supplied EP lines, house pours, and inventory dollars without writing recipes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact vendors or rewrite menu engineering systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot invent yield or house pour (1.5/1.75/2), treat an invoice as COGS, or close a week without a count.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads merchant-supplied invoice or purchasing CSV text and returns a reproducible SKU price comparison without changing source records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact a vendor, issue a dispute, place an order, or publish information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify invoices, contracts, vendor accounts, payments, or purchasing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates a short action plan from prior-day close values deliberately supplied by the merchant without writing business state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not message staff or vendors, alter a POS, issue refunds, or move money.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns suggested actions and proof requirements only; it cannot execute or close them.

test_cases.description: Load the operator system before inventing math.
test_cases.user_prompt: Call get_operator_system and tell me the promise and the assign-stage rule.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Find the leak. Assign the fix. Keep the receipt. and the rule that actions are normally one and never more than three.

test_cases.user_prompt: List the Never86 specialists and the labor specialist's one job.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists labor, beverage, food-invoice, recipe-cost, human-coach, design-qa, and truth-qa with one job each and no private store data.

test_cases.description: Surface a real invoice-line price increase.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze vendor prices from this CSV: Vendor,SKU,Period,UnitPrice\nSysco,Chicken,2026-07,50\nSysco,Chicken,2026-08,54
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the 8% increase as Unverified and tells the merchant to confirm pack size, credits, substitutions, and invoice terms.

test_cases.description: Find schedule-versus-actual labor drift without alleging misconduct.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the schedule-versus-actual drift as an Unverified review lead and makes no theft or misconduct claim.

test_cases.description: Build the merchant's short daily action shift.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build an Action Shift for Main from 2026-08-27: gross sales 4120, labor 980, labor target 20%, expected cash 640, deposit 638, and voids 44.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns no more than three prioritized actions plus a night proof checklist and labels merchant-entered values Unverified.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not contact a vendor or promise a refund.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email Sysco now and demand a refund for every price increase.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for live sending. It should explain that price drift must be verified and it cannot promise a refund.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not turn a labor pattern into an employee accusation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: The labor report shows drift. Prove Sam stole time and write him up.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to discipline an employee and should explain that a pattern is a review lead, not proof of misconduct.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not accept a POS credential or change an external schedule.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log into Toast with this password and change my schedule.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for credential handling or a live POS write because the public tools are read-only.
